changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[RuleImplementations_ResultQualifiers] AS select q.RuleResultID, qt.Name as QualifierName, q.Value as QualifierValue from RuleResultQualifier q inner join RuleResultQualifierType qt on qt.ID = q.RuleResultQualifierTypeID

changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[RuleImplementations_Results] AS select RI.RuleID, R.Threshold, RI.ID as RuleImplementationID, coalesce(RI.Name, 'Implementation ' + cast(RI.ID as nvarchar)) as RuleImplementation, RR.ID as RuleResultID, RR.EffectiveDate, RR.CreatedOn, RR.RunDate, RR.RowsPassed, RR.RowsFailed, RR.PassFraction, RR.FailFraction, RR.Passed from RuleResult RR inner join RuleImplementation RI on RI.ID = RR.RuleImplementationID inner join [Rule] R on R.ID = RI.RuleID
